title: 龍が如く2

versions.note: Disc 1. A PS2 emulator names this build SLPM-66602-c6b95c48

sources: The harness alone, from the game's file (docs/first-script.md): no reader's snapshots, no memory written
The characters read off the game's own pictures of them, in the rows of text they stand in (yomikata unread); a second reader (manga-ocr) beside

Played from power-on: the prologue's five scenes, the graveyard in play (a window with its speaker, a question and its answers), the recollection of the first game, and the scene that follows, to the first fight

What the script said in play agreed with the lines read off 118 of 119 pictures, over 8 scenes; the other shows a question with its answers, of which the script says the answers there (the question the page before). It read nothing on 4 screens that show no text
notes: Read by the script games/ps2/SLPM-66602.lua; there is no layout. Only disc 1 was played, for its first half hour. A scene's subtitles and what people say in play come in blocks, each with a font of its own: a code is a glyph's number there, so only the picture says which character it is. The script knows a glyph by a hash of its picture (SLPM-66602.glyphs): the 602 of what was played, hangul among them; others come out as U+FFFD. Who speaks in a scene, a fight's instructions and menus aren't read.
